_comment: Types declared on both sides whose field sets legitimately differ. Each entry needs a reason; the drift checker (scripts/verify-bridge-types.mjs) skips them.

reasons.SavePptxEditorAssetInput: renderer carries bytes as `data: Uint8Array`; bridge.ts encodes them into Go's `dataBase64` before the call
reasons.SavePptxEditorSnapshotInput: renderer `content: Uint8Array` becomes Go `contentBase64` in bridge.ts
reasons.StageXlsxEditorImageInput: renderer `data: Uint8Array` becomes Go `dataBase64` in bridge.ts
